name: Iran
description: Follow Iran, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Talks between Iran, Oman continue over Strait of Hormuz
changes.summary: Negotiations are ongoing between Iran and Oman regarding the management of the Strait of Hormuz. While those talks over the crucial waterway drag on, however, gas prices remain high for Americans. Imtiaz Tyab reports.

changes.title: Iran sets steep demands to reopen Hormuz despite hopes Oman deal could break impasse
changes.summary: There are no ongoing negotiations between Tehran and Washington, Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said Sunday, after Tehran set out a steep series of demands for the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.

changes.title: Iran Says There’s Still No Deal on Reopening the Strait of Hormuz
changes.summary: Iran is issuing a new set of demands to President Donald Trump and American negotiators before it will consider re-opening the vital Strait of Hormuz. The demands require the United States to never threat or insult Iran, withdraw military forces and compensate for damages during the war. NBC’s Keir Simmons reports for.

changes.title: Yemen's Houthis claim attack on Aramco oil facility in Saudi Arabia, and other Middle East news
changes.summary: Meanwhile, Iran has made new demands about the restart of negotiations and the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, and the Pentagon is pressing the U.S. defense industry to accelerate production of weapons. (Image credit: Vahid Salemi).

changes.title: Iran denies any direct talks with U.S. on opening Strait of Hormuz as Houthis claim attack on Saudi refinery
changes.summary: Iran's foreign minister reportedly said his country is not engaging in talks with the U.S., but added: "Messages are being exchanged through intermediaries.".

changes.title: Haunted by Hoover, Trump searches for an endgame in Iran
changes.summary: President Trump is confronting a question that has haunted presidents throughout history: how a war - that has gone on longer than predicted - can reshape a presidency. (Image credit: KENT NISHIMURA).

changes.title: Pakistan says new defense pact with Saudi Arabia and Turkey is 'purely defensive' and open to others
changes.summary: The landmark Mecca Joint Defense Agreement was signed on Friday as the three countries seek to deepen security cooperation amid heightened tensions between the United States and Iran.

changes.title: Iran issues new demands over Strait of Hormuz
changes.summary: Iran on Saturday issued a new list of demands to the United States, complicating efforts to reopen the critical Strait of Hormuz. NBC News’ Keir Simmons reports from Doha.

changes.title: The U.S. Is Burning Through Weapons in Iran. Russia and China Are Taking Note.
changes.summary: The Iran war has depleted U.S. weapons stockpiles, resulting in a significant erosion of firepower. A more drawn-out Iran conflict benefits Moscow and Beijing, some analysts say.
